headline: Michael Sianipar Responds To Proposed Extraordinary Congress Of FFI
seoTitle: Michael Sianipar On FFI Extraordinary Congress
metaDescription: Michael Sianipar addresses plans for the Federasi Futsal Indonesia extraordinary congress, discussing internal governance and club subsidies.
aiSummaryBullets: Michael Sianipar provided a detailed timeline regarding the internal issues currently facing the Federasi Futsal Indonesia.
The FFI chairperson expressed concerns regarding the necessity of an extraordinary congress scheduled for December 11, 2026.
Discussions are ongoing concerning organizational management, club subsidy structures, and the broader administrative future of the federation.
aiContextParagraph: The Federasi Futsal Indonesia (FFI) is currently experiencing an internal leadership dispute involving Chairperson Michael Sianipar and Budi Setiawan. The conflict follows Budi Setiawan's push for an extraordinary congress, citing concerns over the organization's governance, administrative accountability, and the current funding models for member clubs. Budi Setiawan has previously articulated his perspective on his own dismissal and the perceived need for reform within the federation's structure. In recent public statements, Michael Sianipar has responded to these calls by detailing the chronological events that led to the current friction within the body. He has also addressed questions surrounding the sustainability of financial support for clubs and the strategic direction of the sport. The situation remains a point of focus as stakeholders prepare for the upcoming congress intended to evaluate the federation's leadership and operational procedures.
whyItIsViral: The story is gaining traction through coverage by two independent news outlets that are reporting on the internal administrative conflict at the federation.
